jobs.occupation: Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in (m/w/d) (Wissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in)
jobs.description: Die Technische Universität Chemnitz ist eine innovative Wissenschafts- und Bildungseinrichtung, die sich den Herausforderungen im Wettbewerb zwischen den Hochschulen bewusst stellt. Sie bietet Persönlichkeiten mit ausgewiesener fachlicher Kompetenz, die konstruktiv an der innovativen Weiterentwicklung mitwirken möchten, attraktive Arbeitsplätze.Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt ist an der Fakultät für Mathematik, Professur für Harmonische Analysis vorbehaltlich der Bereitstellung und Bewilligung der Drittmittel durch den Deutschen Forschungsgemeinschaft – DFG eine Stelle als vollzeitbeschäftigte/rWissenschaftliche/r Mitarbeiter/in - Postdoc (m/w/d)(100 %, Entgeltgruppe 13 TV-L)befristet für zwei Jahre zu besetzen. Die befristete Einstellung erfolgt gemäß den Regelungen des Wissenschaftszeitvertragsgesetzes (WissZeitVG) und des Sächsischen Hochschulgesetzes (SächsHSG) in der jeweils geltenden Fassung.Arbeitsaufgaben:- Durchführung von Forschung im DFG-geförderten Projekt „The Manifold of Embeddings“- Unterstützung bei der Betreuung von Abschlussarbeiten im Zusammenhang mit dem Projekt- Aktive Teilnahme an Seminaren und anderen wissenschaftlichen Aktivitäten des Projekts oder der Forschungsgruppe- Organisation wissenschaftlicher Veranstaltungen im Rahmen des ProjektsIhre Forschungsergebnisse nutzen Sie für wissenschaftliche Veröffentlichungen und die eigene Qualifizierung. Es handelt sich um eine Stelle zur wissenschaftlichen Weiterqualifikation.Wenn Sie die Zusammenarbeit in einem interdisziplinären, hoch motivierten Team und die akademische Auseinandersetzung mit einem Thema hoher praktischer Relevanz reizen, sollten Sie die Einstellungskriterien gem. § 73 SächsHSG erfüllen, insbesondere folgende Voraussetzungen mitbringen:- Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium inkl. Doktorat in Mathematik (die Dissertation muss vor Beginn der Tätigkeit abgeschlossen sein)- Solide Kenntnisse in geometrischer und/oder numerischer Analysis und/oder Optimierung- Sehr gute mündliche und schriftliche Kenntnisse der deutschen oder englischen Sprache (min-destens C1-Niveau)Weitere wünschenswerte Qualifikationen:- Kenntnisse in geometrischen Krümmungsfunktionalen (insbesondere abstoßenden Energien) und unendlichdimensionaler Differentialgeometrie- Profizienz in mindestens einer der folgenden Programmiersprachen/Umgebungen: Mathemati-ca, MATLAB, C++, Python- Erfahrung im Erhalt von Drittmittelförderung und in internationalen ForschungskooperationenWir bieten Ihnen:- Mitarbeit in einem kooperativen und hilfsbereiten Team- Attraktive und familienfreundliche Arbeitsbedingungen- Vielfältiges Mensaangebot für die Pausenversorgung- Optimale Verkehrsanbindung aller Universitätsstandorte an den öffentlichen Personennahver-kehr / Vergünstigungen bei der Nutzung des ÖPNV (Job-Ticket)- Attraktive Angebote der Gesundheitsförderung- Vielfältige Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten- 30 Tage kalenderjährlichen Urlaub bei einer 5-Tage-Arbeitswoche- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL), Jahressonderzahlung und vermögenswirksame LeistungenDie Auswahl erfolgt nach Eignung, Befähigung und fachlicher Leistung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen – unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion/Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Wir bieten darüber hinaus allen Mitarbeitenden eine familienfreundliche Infrastruktur, in einem weltoffenen, von Internationalisierung und Vielfältigkeit geprägten Umfeld. Die TU Chemnitz setzt aktiv auf die Vielfalt und Gleichstellung aller Mitarbeitenden und ist bestrebt, schwerbehinderte Menschen oder ihnen Gleichgestellte besonders zu fördern, achtet im Bewerbungsverfahren bei gleicher Eignung auf eine bevorzugte Berücksichtigung und bittet daher um einen entsprechenden Hinweis in Ihrer Bewerbung.Bewerbungen sind mit den unten genannten Unterlagen bis 30. November 2026 elektronisch über unser Online-Bewerbungsportal (https://jobs.tu-chemnitz.de/jobposting/8cba238e2089e0fb7d7fa4ba687901f3d17527b20) zu richten. Bitte beachten Sie, dass aus sicherheitstechnischen Gründen keine elektronischen Bewerbungen bzw. Anhänge von Bewerbungen im Stellenbesetzungsverfahren berücksichtigt werden können, welche über Verknüpfungen (Hyperlinks) zu Dritten zum Download zur Verfügung gestellt werden.Wir weisen ausdrücklich darauf hin, dass Bewerbungen per E-Mail, zur Gewährleistung der Datensicherheit, nicht berücksichtigt werden. Bevorzugen Sie dennoch einen anderen Bewerbungsweg als über unser Onlineportal, steht Ihnen Frau Ebert (Tel. +49 371 531-34111) gern zur Verfügung.Bewerbungsunterlagen (in deutscher oder englischer Sprache):1. Bewerbungsanschreiben (max. eine DIN-A4-Seite), in dem Ihre Stärken und Ihre Relevanz für das Projekt dargestellt werden. Bitte geben Sie auch an, ab welchem Zeitpunkt Sie die Stelle antreten könnten.2. Lebenslauf (ausführlich, inklusive Ausbildung, aktueller Tätigkeit, Berufserfahrung, Arbeitslücken, Interessen, außerschulische Aktivitäten, internationale Erfahrungen sowie Projekte, die Programmier-/Softwarekenntnisse und projektbezogenes Wissen belegen).3. Liste der Publikationen (einschließlich DOIs; PDFs nicht beifügen).4. Forschungsplan (max. eine DIN-A4-Seite; bis zu zwei Seiten bei Einbeziehung einer Abbildung).5. Kopien der Abschlusszeugnisse (BSc, MSc, PhD).6. Transcript of Records für BSc, MSc und PhD (falls die Promotion noch nicht abgeschlossen ist, geben Sie die erbrachten Leistungen und Noten an).7. Englische Zusammenfassung der Doktorarbeit (max. eine DIN-A4-Seite; bis zu zwei Seiten bei Einbeziehung einer Abbildung).8. Schriftliche Einverständniserklärung zur Kontaktaufnahme mit zwei Referenten (einschließlich vollständiger Kontaktdaten). Die Referenten müssen in der Lage und berechtigt sein, auf Anfrage eine Empfehlung abzugeben.9. Optional: Nachweis der Englischkenntnisse (z. B. TOEFL, IELTS).Ansprechpartner:- Allgemeine Fragen zum Bewerbungsverfahren: Frau Ebert, Tel. +49 371 531-34111- Fachliche oder projektbezogene Fragen: Prof. Reiter, Tel. +49 371 531-31585Weitere Informationen:- Institution: https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/ (https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/)- Forschungsgruppe: https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/mathematik/harmonische_analysis/ (https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/mathematik/harmonische_analysis/)Informationen zur Erhebung und Verarbeitung personenbezogener Daten: https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/verwaltung/personal/public/Datenschutz/dse_dp_tucrecruitung.html (https://www.tu-chemnitz.de/verwaltung/personal/public/Datenschutz/dse_dp_tucrecruitung.html)Open PositionChemnitz University of Technology – an established, innovative scientific and educational institution that actively meets the challenges of competition among universities – offers attractive positions to individuals with proven scientific excellence who wish to contribute to further innovative development.As soon as possible, the Faculty of Mathematics, subject to the availability of third party funding, is seeking to fill aPostdoctoral Researcher (m/f/d)100 % (Pay Grade 13 TV L)for a fixed term of two years in the Chair of Harmonic Analysis. The appointment will be made in accordance with the German Act on Fixed Term Academic Employment Contracts (WissZeitVG) and the Saxon Higher Education Act (SächsHSG), in the version currently in force.Responsibilities- Conduct research within the DFG funded project “The Manifold of Embeddings.”- Assist in supervising theses related to the project.- Actively take part in seminars and other scientific activities of the project or the research group.- Organise scientific events related to the project.You will use your research results for scientific publications and for your own further qualification. This is a position for further scientific qualification.Required qualifications (§ 73 SächsHSG)- A completed university degree and a doctoral degree in mathematics (the dissertation must be defended prior to the start of the appointment).- Solid knowledge of geometric and/or numerical analysis and/or optimisation.- Very good oral and written German or English (minimum C1 level).Desirable additional qualifications- Knowledge of geometric curvature functionals (especially repulsive energies) and of infinite dimensional differential geometry.- Proficiency in at least one of the following programming languages/environments: Mathematica, MATLAB, C++, Python.- Experience in securing third party funding and in international research collaborations.We offer- Collaboration within a cooperative, supportive team.- Attractive and family friendly working conditions.- A wide range of cafeteria options for break time meals.- Excellent public transport connections to all university campuses, including discounted public transport passes (Job Ticket).- Attractive health promotion programmes.- Extensive opportunities for further education and professional development.- 30 calendar days of annual leave per year for a five day workweek.- Occupational pension scheme (VBL), annual special payment, and asset building benefits.The full job-offer can bei found at www.tu-chemnitz.de/stellenONLINE-BEWERBUNG (https://jobs.tu-chemnitz.de/jobposting/8cba238e2089e0fb7d7fa4ba687901f3d17527b20)

jobs.occupation: Project Manager (f/m/d) Supplier Relationship & Resilience (Orion) (Projektleiter/in / Projektmanager/in)
jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As a Project Manager (f/md) for Supplier Relationship Management & Supply Chain Resilience, you will work closely with the management team of GS D Procurement and the Gas Services Project Orion. Your role is essential to drive objectives of the ORION project to de-risk the GS D supply chain. In this role you report to the Head of Commodity Management and will work closely with the head of GS D procurement and the CPOs of the product lines, as well as the project organization in Gas Services. The tasks range from monitoring, improvement and developing the supplier relationship management and risk-mitigation in the supply chain. How You’ll Make an Impact * Establish, maintain, and actively manage supplier relationship management activities* Analyze supply chain de-risking activities across GS D, benchmark and exchange with Orion project team members on Gas Services level, drive improvements and process harmonization* Drive cost-saving initiatives and risk-mitigation actions together with commodity managers, project management, finance, engineering, and supply chain teams* Increase data-driven decision making, leveraging integrated supply chain tools and support of AI* Prepare transparent project progress tracking, identifying risks and taking mitigation action with SQ, Procurement, Engineering in GS DWhat You Bring* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field, combined with project management skills, and understanding of supply chain topics across the value chain from Sales, to Engineering and to Procurement. * Longstanding professional experience in managing complex projects, financial analysis, procurement, or a comparable environment, typically gained over 5+ years.* Strong collaboration, stakeholder-management, strategic-thinking, influencing, and process-improvement skills across procurement, finance, project management, and supply chain interfaces.* Proven ability to manage complex projects with cross-functional stakeholders and track record of realizing project targets on time & on budget.* Fluent in English and German is an advantage About the TeamOur Gas Services division offers Low-emission power generation through service and decarbonization. Zero or low emission power generation and all gas turbines under one roof, steam turbines and generators. Decarbonization opportunities through service offerings, modernization, and digitalization of the fleet.Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs Ongoing selection is applied; the role might be filled before last application date.For questions about the role, please contact the recruiting manager Lina Himmelreich on lina.himmelreich.ext@siemens-energy.com or tel. +491727619376For questions about the recruitment process please contact the recruiter responsible.We refrain from all contact with staffing and recruitment companies, or advertising brokers.Trade Union Representatives:Anders Häll, Unionen, 0122-887514Simon Von Eckardstein (Sveriges Ingenjörer) 0122-842 24,Jan Lundgren (Ledarna) 0122-812 33, Jonny Persson (IF Metall) 0122-817 69

jobs.occupation: Air Freight Pricing Specialist (f/m/d) (Kaufmann/-frau - Spedition und Logistikdienstleistung)
jobs.description: Welcome to Rhenus!The Rhenus Group is one of the leading global logistics service providers. Throughout the entire supply chain, we offer tailored solutions for companies across a wide range of industries. From multimodal transportation and optimal warehousing to seamless customs clearance and innovative value-added services, we stay at the forefront of industry developments and work closely alongside our customers every step of the way.What you can expect:- In this position, you will receive, review and process ad-hoc pricing requests from both the global network and own-controlled customers - including the clarification of customer requirements, if needed.- In addition, you will work closely with local operations and sales to understand customer needs, apply pricing according to local price sensitivity, and support the execution of margin and pricing strategies.- You will foster exchange with the Airfreight Pricing & Procurement Team (e.g., for shipment solutions over 1.5 tons) and the Gateway Team in Frankfurt to develop competitive and operationally feasible solutions.- Furthermore, you will ensure thorough documentation of all quotations and provide insightful reporting to local P&L responsible parties, local sales, the airfreight product team, and the Gateway.- Last but not least, you will be responsible for the follow-up on all provided spot quotations and related inquiries - ensuring feedback is received, success rates are monitored through standard reporting, and coordination with the Commercial Team is maintained. You will also follow customer-specific pricing instructions precisely.What you bring:- You have already gained previous experience in airfreight operations or sales, providing a solid foundation in industry processes and commercial dynamics.- A self-reliant working style combined with the ability to perform well under pressure in time-sensitive environments is one of your key strengths.- You have a confident and professional demeanor in negotiations and in communication with both customers and suppliers.- Naturally, you bring a strong numerical understanding and a sharp eye for detail, supporting accurate and data-driven decision-making.- Business fluency in English, along with strong verbal and written communication skills, round off your profile.Your benefits:- Cafeteria: Fuel your day with nutritious meals at our on-site cafeteria.- Continuous Training: Sharpen your skills and advance your expertise with our professional development programs.- Exclusive Discounts: Benefit from attractive employee discounts on different products and services.- Flexible Working Times: We offer flexible schedules to suit your lifestyle and personal commitments.- Free Parking: No one likes to start their day hunting for a spot - we've got guaranteed free parking spaces for everyone.- Monthly Gift Vouchers: Enjoy an extra amount each month for fuel, groceries, or entertainment.

jobs.occupation: IT Application Manager Robotron eSales (m/f/d) (Anwendungsprogrammierer/in)
jobs.description: Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:IT Application Manager/inStellenbeschreibung:ENGIE Germany stands for combined expertise in the transition to climate neutrality, offering comprehensive energy solutions and services ranging from plant engineering to carbon neutrality. More than 5,500 employees at 50 locations are already making a real difference when it comes to climate neutrality.  How do we do that? For example, we develop and implement sustainable solutions in the areas of wind, solar, hydro, and energy storage. Or we plan and build process facilities for our customers in the energy and utilities sectors. Or we provide technical building management support for heating, plumbing, HVAC, and refrigeration systems. And so on. As you can see, we’re shaping the future of energy - together.   Your tomorrow starts today! In this role, you will enable the business to use the EDM system efficiently, as well as manage the whole application and it’s interfaces.As the central expert for robotron eSales, you will work closely with business stakeholders, internal IT teams, and external vendors to maintain high availability, optimize processes, and drive digital excellence.Your responsibilities:Application Ownership & Operations- Serve as the primary application expert and strategic product owner for Robotron eSales, driving the product vision and roadmap- Ensure stable, secure, and reliable daily operation of the solution, including incident, problem, and change management- Coordinate maintenance, upgrades, and integrations in line with IT standardsBusiness Support & Enhancement- Act as the key interface between business and technical teams- Analyze business requirements, prioritize the product backlog, and translate them into technical specifications or user stories- Manage enhancements, configurations, and system optimizations to support evolving business needs and maximize business valueProject & Vendor Management- Lead or contribute to digitalization and automation initiatives leveraging Robotron eSales- Take ownership of vendor management by effectively managing relationships with Robotron and other external service providers to ensure SLA fulfillment and timely feature delivery- Support implementation projects, testing, and release cyclesQuality, Security & Compliance- Ensure data quality, system documentation, and audit readiness- Promote adherence to IT security, data protection, and compliance standardsYour profile:- Degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience- Several years of proven experience as a Product Owner or Application Manager specifically with Robotron eSalesGood understanding of German and/or European energy market processes (e.g., billing, EDM, market communication)- Hands-on knowledge of: - SQL databases- Interfaces/API concepts (EDIFACT, AS4, REST)- Application lifecycle management- Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a proactive, customer-oriented approach- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills to effectively align with business leaders and external vendors- Fluent in German and EnglishWhat We Offer You:- **EXCITING EXTRAS:** Discounts, e-bikes, services, and technology from leading providers via our ENGIE platform.  - **FAMILY AND CAREER:** Up to 150 € toward childcare or preschool fees.  - **FLEXIBLE WORK:** At ENGIE, you get the flexibility you need to successfully complete your tasks.- **MAKE THE MOST OF YOUR POTENTIAL:** Training sessions, workshops, and continuing education—do what helps you and us grow.    - jobs.occupation: Join Native Nanny – International Childcare Opportunities in Duisburg (Kinderbetreuer/in)
jobs.description: At Native Nanny, we specialize in international childcare placements across Germany. We connect families with caring, qualified childcare professionals – and help nannies, babysitters, and tutors with international backgrounds find the right family match.We are currently looking for experienced nannies, babysitters, and tutors to work with families in Duisburg and the surrounding areas. If you speak English, French, Italian, or another widely spoken language, we’d love to hear from you!Your Responsibilities- Provide loving, attentive, and safe care for children.- Organize and structure daily routines with age-appropriate activities such as games, creative play, reading, or homework support.- Accompany children to and from school, nursery, or extracurricular activities.- Handle light, child-related housekeeping: meal prep, tidying play areas, laundry, etc.Your Profile- Experience with children or babies is essential. A background in education or childcare is a strong advantage.- You’re caring, empathetic, and genuinely enjoy working with children.- You’re reliable, organized, and flexible in your schedule.- You have a friendly, open, and professional attitude.- You speak English, French, Italian, or another common European language fluently.Why Join Us?- Bring your cultural diversity and language skills into a role where they truly make a difference.- Get matched with families that value your skills and background.- Be part of a trusted network of international childcare professionals.If you're passionate about childcare and want to make a difference in a family’s life, we’d love to hear from you!Apply now by submitting your CV directly on our website.We look forward to welcoming you to the Native Nanny community!
